task_title: Expose AI runner world feature flags

plan_review.notes: Revised plan adds CLI parse/help/forwarding, explicit selected-vs-applied flag snapshots, floor/target applicability metadata, enabled and independence-matrix coverage, and uses ScenarioInitializationOptions as the shared seam. Reuses the existing Apply staged + restart button, with flag-specific stale status and labeling, rather than adding a competing restart mechanism.
